note: Literature directly demonstrates MAPK8IP3/JIP3 mediates retrograde axonal transport of lysosomes and endocytic cargo, and its disruption impairs endolysosomal maturation in axons and neuronal soma.

evidence.text: Loss of JIP3 causes endolysosomal maturation defects within neuronal cell bodies, expansion of immature lysosomes, decrease in mature lysosomes, and delayed trafficking of endocytic cargo.

source.title: Ultrastructural studies reveal a new role for JIP3/MAPK8IP3 ...
source.quote: Through this, we identify endolysosomal maturation defects within neuronal cell bodies of iNeurons lacking JNK-Interacting Protein 3 (JIP3), a lysosome adaptor previously known to primarily regulate axonal lysosome movement. Loss of JIP3 results in an expansion of immature lysosomes within neuronal soma, along with a concomitant decrease in mature lysosomes. JIP3 loss also leads to delayed trafficking of endocytic cargo through these compartments

evidence.text: Mutations in MAPK8IP3 disrupt retrograde axonal transport, causing lysosome-filled axonal swellings and neurodevelopmental pathology.
